summary: Validate first material history without misclassifying baseline-equivalent imports

delivery.outcome: Correct first-material history checking for baseline-equivalent imported payloads while preserving intent atomicity for every new material change, including merge resolutions.
nonGoals: No cleanup, ownership or migration grants
No consumer managed-file edits before qualified source release
No changes to active ticket402 version, release or CI scopes; no package version advance in this source patch

architecture.decision: Inspect each commit against its first parent and compare changed material paths with the exact base tree. Baseline-equivalent entries introduce no new implementation. Use topological order; preserve rejection of non-equivalent side histories, transient changes and late intent. Register real-Git regressions in the existing required validator harness. Never infer migration authority or cleanup permission from this check.
architecture.rollback: Independently reviewed revert of the bounded gate/test patch; keep current adopted pins and private consumer preservation unchanged.

commands: Real Git baseline-equivalent import and synthetic CI merge regressions
Negative late-intent, mode/deletion, transient payload, non-equivalent import and Git-error regressions
Goal publication preflight; exact-head protected CI and independent Validator
